verduurzamen.h1: Becoming more sustainable without grid reinforcement
verduurzamen.sub: The switch from gas to electric requires extra capacity, but the grid operator often cannot deliver. Lemnion combines sustainability with battery storage, so you can go gas-free without putting extra strain on the grid.
verduurzamen.label: Keep reading
verduurzamen.h2: Gas-free = more power, but the grid is full
verduurzamen.lead: Hospitality wants to become more sustainable. Replacing gas boilers with heat pumps, gas stoves with induction, gas-fired boilers with electric hot water buffers. But every step requires extra electrical capacity · and the grid operator often cannot deliver a heavier connection. Hotels are forced to keep burning gas, while CO₂ targets get closer and the gas price keeps rising.
verduurzamen.c1p: A heat pump replaces your gas boiler and can save up to 75% on your gas bill. But a heat pump requires 3-phase power, exactly what the grid operator often cannot deliver. Lemnion combines the heat pump with battery storage: the battery absorbs the peak demand, so you stay within your connection capacity.
verduurzamen.c2p: From gas stove to induction: safer, more precise and better for the climate. But a professional kitchen with induction draws peak currents your grid connection was not designed for. With battery storage you supply those peaks from your battery, not from the grid.
verduurzamen.c3p: Gas-fired hot water buffers consume gas continuously, even when there are no guests. Electric boilers combined with a smart battery charge during cheap off-peak hours and deliver hot water exactly when your guests need it.
